about_description: A toolbox of handy utilities for select Lenovo tablets with Qualcomm chipsets
about_disclaimer: Educational use only · use at your own risk
adv_arb_inspect_subtitle: Read from the picked firmware folder. The next step asks for the new target value.
adv_convert_xml_desc: Decrypt encrypted rawprogram packs so they can be reviewed or edited as XML.
adv_country_needs_system: Available only when the device is connected over system (ADB).
adv_country_subtitle: Choose the country to change this device's code to.
adv_detect_arb_desc: Check whether the connected device has rollback protection enabled.
adv_dump_partitions_desc: Back up selected device partitions as image files over EDL.
adv_dump_physical_desc: Create raw backups of whole physical storage LUNs over EDL.
adv_flash_partitions_desc: Flash chosen image files to selected device partitions over EDL.
adv_flash_physical_desc: Write raw images to whole physical storage LUNs over EDL.
adv_image_info_desc: Inspect AVB metadata, hashes, rollback indices, and descriptors from image files.
adv_overview_subtitle: Access advanced tools and workflows for device maintenance.
adv_patch_arb_desc: Patch boot and vbmeta_system rollback indexes to the target value.
adv_patch_devinfo_desc: Change the device country code by dumping, patching, and reflashing model-specific partitions over EDL.
adv_rebuild_vbmeta_desc: Refresh matching hash and hashtree descriptors in vbmeta.img from partition images.
adv_region_convert_desc: Patch vendor_boot so the firmware reports the selected PRC or ROW region.
adv_region_target_desc: Opens the PRC / ROW target picker.
adv_region_target_subtitle: Pick PRC or ROW for the patched vendor_boot output.
adv_simple_flash_desc: Run a near-stock firmware flash flow without LTBox checks or image modifications.
adv_src_detect_arb: vbmeta.img to read its rollback index
adv_src_dump_partitions: EDL loader to scan the device and dump partitions
adv_src_dump_physical: EDL loader to dump whole physical LUNs
adv_src_flash_partitions: Firmware folder to cherry-pick partitions from
adv_src_flash_physical: EDL loader to flash raw images onto whole LUNs
adv_src_image_info: One or more .img files to inspect
adv_src_rebuild_vbmeta: vbmeta.img (matching partition images must be in the same folder)
apatch_superkey_mismatch: The two entries don't match. Enter the superkey again from the start.
apatch_superkey_subtitle: 8–63 alphanumeric characters. Used as the root authorization key — keep it private.
apatch_superkey_verify_subtitle: Enter the same superkey one more time to confirm. Mismatch resets the flow.
arb_detect_is_anti_rollback: This device has rollback protection enabled.

err_flash_efisp_work_dir_failed: efisp EFI work directory creation failed: {error}
err_flash_model_mismatch_pre_edl: Flash: firmware/device model mismatch - aborting before EDL

settings_default_loader_unset: Not set — picker shown each time
settings_qcom_driver_mode_help: Switching installs the selected driver family and uses that transport for EDL.
settings_qcom_driver_mode_linux_unsuppor: The Qualcomm kernel driver requires a Debian-based Linux distribution, so only userspace mode is available here.
settings_qcom_driver_mode_macos: macOS has no Qualcomm kernel driver, so userspace mode is always used.
simple_flash_confirm_warning: ⚠ Skips all safety checks. Whether user data is wiped depends on the firmware package.
